dimension_info.onwind: Installed onshore wind capacity, summed over all 34 nodes.
dimension_info.offwind-ac: Installed offshore wind capacity with AC grid connection, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.offwind-float: Installed floating offshore wind capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.solar: Installed fixed-tilt solar PV capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.solar-hsat: Installed single-axis tracking solar PV capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.CCGT: Installed combined-cycle gas turbine capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.battery: Installed battery storage energy capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.H2: Installed hydrogen storage energy capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.system_cost: Total annual system cost (annualised capital plus operational costs). This is the objective function being minimized.
